objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle. Encompasses policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction etc.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1-4) in the document pyramid indicating strategic to operational scope.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in document naming (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on content or attribute changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period for archival retention before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content, relevant for translation.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to other referenced documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to relevant IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute specifying companies relevant to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute specifying organizational areas where the document applies.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is automatically released with the main document release and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-controlled document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be directly published or deleted.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before document validity expiry to check and potentially extend document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used for assigning read or change authorizations and distribution to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons maintained per document who are informed about document releases via email or acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process flow that manages approval steps including creator signing, review and release with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity such as a department or location that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object that can be linked to documents in the system.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view that presents relevant documents and evaluation information based on distribution group membership.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report with selection parameters and criteria for filtering and evaluating documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report such as Status Report, Search for Documents, Status Report for Acknowledgement.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The selected template used for creating the document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers in the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes are made to content, attributes or attachments.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled Attachment sub-document is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing Attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An Attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An Additional Information supplement is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An Additional Information supplement is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a Change Proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A Change Proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the assigned Change Proposal, notifying the creator of the proposal.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change permissions are assigned to users or user groups for a specific document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document and its attachments are declared out of force and archived with revocation of all rights except archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is re-validated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users about workflow tasks, status changes or distribution events.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary to a Document without affecting its release cycle.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity needs checking.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request for Reactivation references the invalidated Document to be reactivated.
One or more Document Templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating Documents.
A Document can reference another Document via the References attribute.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document can be linked to a Risk.
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups that determine their authorizations and roles.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to manage notification recipients.
A Distribution List contains assigned User Groups for distribution.
A Distribution List contains directly assigned persons for distribution.
A User Group is assigned to a Document to control read or change authorizations.
